title: Source-root naming bind adopts a session_bind token without checking status.session_id
outcome: The source-root naming bind (src/engram_source_roots.rs, around lines 1959–1978) validates Engram's session_bind answer the same way the turn binder and the recovery replay do. Before adopting the routing token it requires a non-empty token, a phase, and status.session_id equal to the session (engram_validated_bind_answer). Otherwise it fails closed and adopts nothing.
acceptance: Source-root naming bind adopts a session_bind token without checking status.session_id is done
